title: Set a crew member's hourly cost

steps.caption: Team
steps.narration: Keep each crew member's hourly cost on their team card. It takes a few seconds.

steps.caption: Marco's card
steps.narration: On the Team tab, every person has a card. Find the one you want.

steps.caption: Cost rate / hr
steps.narration: Cost rate per hour is what an hour of their time costs your company.

steps.caption: Type the rate
steps.narration: To change it, click the field and type the new rate.

steps.caption: Leave the field
steps.narration: Then press Tab, or click anywhere else. It saves by itself, and a note confirms it.

steps.caption: The new rate
steps.narration: The new rate now shows on his card.

steps.caption: See costs and margins
steps.narration: Cost rates stay private. Only people with See costs and margins can see them.

steps.caption: Manage team
steps.narration: And changing one also takes Manage team and invitations.

steps.caption: Clear it
steps.narration: To remove a rate, clear the field and click away.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find it under Team and Company, in the left menu.

youtube.title: How to set a crew member's hourly cost | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Set the hourly cost rate for a team member in ConstructHUB CRM: find their card on the Team tab, type the rate and click away to save. See which permissions let someone view or change cost rates. The walkthrough uses a demo company and demo team.
